gloss: to stare at; to gaze fixedly at

definitions.gloss: to stare at; to gaze fixedly at; to watch intently
definitions.explanation: To look at something or someone with a steady, unmoving gaze for an extended period, often with concentration, curiosity, or intensity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: She stared fixedly at my face.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{水槽|すいそう}→水槽：09956_suisou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧じっと{見|み}て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The child is gazing intently at the fish in the tank.

examples.japanese: ⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧じっと{見|み}られる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}して→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧しまう。
examples.english: I get nervous when someone stares at me too intently.

notes:
Combines the adverb ⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧ (motionlessly, fixedly) with ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to look). The expression emphasizes a sustained, unwavering gaze. ⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧ itself means "still, without moving" and appears in many other combinations.

RELATED PATTERNS WITH じっと:
- ⟦じっとする→じっとする：25342_jittosuru⟧ — to stay still, to not move
- ⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧⟦{我慢|がまん}する→我慢する：25343_gamansuru⟧ — to endure patiently without reacting
- ⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ — to wait patiently without moving
- ⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧ — to endure stoically

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見|み}つめる→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧ — to gaze at, to stare (single verb; more romantic or emotional nuance)
- ⟦{凝視|ぎょうし}する→凝視する：25402_gyoushisuru⟧ — to stare intently (formal/literary)
- ⟦じろじろ→じろじろ：06907_jirojiro⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ — to stare rudely, to ogle (negative nuance; implies impoliteness)
- ⟦ちらちら→ちらちら：07407_chirachira⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ — to glance repeatedly (furtive, quick looks)

USAGE:
じっと{見|み}る is neutral in tone — it can describe concentration, fascination, worry, or deep thought. Whether the staring is rude or not depends on context, unlike ⟦じろじろ→じろじろ：06907_jirojiro⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ which is always negative.
